Just a boot.|Bayso|Crab's boot?|Gerdis|You just left it out there?|Snee|His foot was still in it! A stump of bloody foot.|attr=Snee reveals her grim discovery to Gerdis's faction of the Maya Pei Brigade|audio=CrabsBoot-SagronaTeema.flac|src={{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}}} '''Snee''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] when it was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|ambushed]] in [[4 BBY]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. She and fourteen other survivors became stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] after the battle and [[Death|killed]] the [[Axis network]] [[pilot]] [[Porko]] before capturing Porko's comrade [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] when he arrived in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. The [[brigade]] tried to interrogate Andor and then debated what to do with the [[prisoner]] and [[starfighter]] until brigade member [[Crab (individual)|Crab]] shot the brigade's pilot [[Rika]] and was in turn shot by brigade member [[Rowd]]. After this, the group broke into two factions, with Snee joining those who sided with self-proclaimed leader [[Gerdis]] while hiding in a wrecked [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]]. Snee was sent out to try and find Crab and Rika's bodies but uncovered only Crab's severed foot. Snee soon grew concerned about the amount of [[Foodstuff|food]] her faction had available and was worried that fellow faction member [[Plug]] had been taken hostage by the other faction when he took longer than expected to return from scouting. He informed her and the others that the other faction, led by brigade member [[Bardi]], was turning the TIE Avenger to aim at Gerdis's group. Later that night, the two groups met to decide what would happen next through a game of [[Five Hands]], dropping their [[weapon]]s while the game took place. They were interrupted by a [[Yavinian doodar]] attacking and carrying off both Gerdis and Bardi in its [[Mouth|maw]], leaving Snee and the others shooting aimlessly. Andor then escaped in the TIE Avenger, leaving them stranded. ==Biography== ===A beleaguered brigade=== {{Quote|We got ambushed. We lost 6 ships, 40 fighters.|Gerdis|audio=Gerdis-Ambushed-OneYearLater.flac|}} Snee was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]], a rebel group led by [[Maya Pei]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], she was part of a group of sixteen [[brigade]] members who survived an [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|ambush]] that destroyed six of the group's [[starship]]s and forty of their [[starfighter]]s. The survivors reached the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' where [[Bardi's brother|one]] of their number, the brother of brigade member [[Bardi]], left them stranded when he took their starship claiming he was going to look for other survivors. The fifteen brigade members left on the moon then encountered [[Porko]], a [[pilot]] for the rebel [[Axis network]] who was waiting for his ally [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] at a rendezvous point on Yavin 4. Porko shot at the survivors and tried to flee, so they [[Death|killed]] him. [[File:Maya-pei-brigade.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Seven members of the Maya Pei Brigade, including Snee, stand over a bound Cassian Andor on Yavin 4 with two other brigade members flanking the prisoner.|Snee and her Maya Pei Brigade comrades captured Cassian Andor on Yavin 4.]] Andor arrived at the rendezvous point in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] two [[Local day|days]] after Snee and her allies had arrived there. The brigade members hid in the undergrowth surrounding the rendezvous point, and their self-proclaimed leader, [[Gerdis]], called out to Andor when he emerged from the [[TIE series|TIE]] and warned him that all fifteen of them had their [[blaster]]s aimed at him, causing him to surrender and try to convince them he was not an Imperial. Bardi began criticizing Gerdis for revealing their numbers, and this bickering between the two continued as they tried to question the [[prisoner]]. Snee and the others stood and watched the interrogation until their pilot, [[Rika]], approached with a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE pilot]] [[helmet]] that she claimed proved Andor was an Imperial test pilot. Snee and the others then aimed their [[weapon]]s at the prisoner. ===A lack of trust=== {{Dialogue|Bardi|She just needs a little time!|Plug|How long will it take?|Snee|And where do we go?|attr=The Maya Pei Brigade discuss their options|audio=NeedsTime-OneYearLater.flac|src=}} While several brigade members took Andor into the TIE Avenger to inspect the [[cockpit]], Snee examined the exterior with her other allies, looking at the starfighter's wings. Leaving Andor by the fighter with brigade member [[Crab (individual)|Crab]] guarding him, the rest of the brigade then gathered by a wrecked [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]] nearby to discuss their options. Snee sat on the ground with her [[Limb|arms]] on her knees as Bardi and Gerdis argued about whether Rika or Andor would need to pilot the starfighter, eventually asking where they would even go once they did leave Yavin 4. [[File:SeatedBrigade-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Most members of the Maya Pei Brigade sit outside the wrecked Breon HOY-39 on Yavin 4.|Snee was uncertain where the Maya Pei Brigade should head if they escaped Yavin 4.]] When the option of making multiple trips was brought up, Snee questioned who would get to be part of the first trip, and soon the brigade began arguing about trust and Bardi's brother. They were interrupted by Andor, who had learned the group's identity from Crab and approached to tell them that he knew Pei and helped supply her. When he refused to reveal specifically [[Luthen Rael|who]] he worked for, Crab became enraged and had to be held back to stop him attacking Andor. ===Divided=== {{Quote|She should be searching the middle. Is that what she's doing?''"
"''I can't tell.|Bayso and Gerdis|audio=Bayso-Gerdis-Searching-SagronaTeema.flac|}} That night, all fifteen survivors and Andor gathered in the middle of the rendezvous point to discuss leadership and what to do next. Gerdis claimed he had been Pei's number two and intended successor, also claiming she had died at the ambush, but Bardi and his allies challenged both these claims. When Rika called Crab a coward and a liar and claimed he had hidden during the ambush, he demanded she take it back, eventually shooting her when she taunted him. [[File:CrabShootsRika-OneYearLater.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Lit by torches at night on Yavin 4, Crab shoots Rika in the chest with a blaster rifle as Snee, Rowd, Bardi, Musk, and Cassian Andor watch.|Snee watched Crab shoot Rika.]] Brigade member [[Rowd]] then shot Crab and the rest of the group descended into a [[Yavin 4 turf war|blasterfight]], which Andor used as an opportunity to try and flee. Brigade members [[Bayso]] and [[Flek]] quickly caught the prisoner and were joined by Gerdis and those backing his leadership claim including Snee, [[Snur]], and [[Plug]]. The group took cover inside the Breon HOY-39 while those who had sided with Bardi hid around the TIE Avenger. Snee was soon sent out to try and find Rika and Crab to see if they had survived and crawled on her [[stomach]] through the [[water]]-logged undergrowth of the rendezvous point. It had begun to rain heavily and this, along with tall [[grass]] and a misty haze limited her vision to no more than a few [[Foot|feet]]{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{AD|Disney+}} causing her to be out searching longer than the others expected. Plug began questioning where she was, and Bayso commented that she should be searching in the middle of the rendezvous point, but Gerdis admitted that he could not tell where Snee had gone. Bardi then called out to [[Nazy]], a member of his faction who had been sent out with the same purpose as Snee, and the sound of his voice caused her to freeze and duck low. ===Trouble is afoot=== {{Quote|That's all that's left?''"
"''You voted to eat.''"
"''And you should've told us "no."|Snee and Bayso|audio=Snee-Bayso-VoteToEat-SagronaTeema.flac|}} [[File:CrabsBoot-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Laying on her stomach in the muddy undergrowth of Yavin 4, Snee stares in horror at the severed foot of Crab, still in its boot, as she holds it up.|Snee discovered Crab's severed foot after he was killed on Yavin 4.]] As Bardi began to call out accusations that Gerdis and his allies had taken Rika's body, Snee came across Crab's [[boot]] poking out from the grass. She grabbed it by the heel and pulled but found it unattached to anything and realized as she lifted it that Crab's [[blood]]y foot was still inside, the rest of him having been taken by animals. She cried out in horror at the discovery, revealing her location to Nazy, who fired a shot at her. Angrily calling out in [[Huttese]], she returned fire as Nazy fled back toward the TIE Avenger, where his allies began providing covering fire. Snee then fled back to the Breon HOY-39 herself, calling out to her allies not to shoot her as they fired at Bardi's group. Inside the Breon HOY-39, Snee told her allies about finding the boot, and when Gerdis questioned why she had not brought the boot with her, she shouted at him about the foot inside. Andor then interrupted and advised the group to catch some rainwater to drink while they had the opportunity. The following [[Standard day|day]], a fog had descended on the rendezvous point, and after voting to eat, which Snee was in favor of, Gerdis's faction took stock of what [[Foodstuff|food]] they had left. When Bayso revealed there were only nine [[meal bar]]s left, Snee was shocked and told Bayso he should have told them no when they voted to eat earlier. She passed Flek a bowl as Andor chimed in that Bardi's group was being awful quiet, prompting Gerdis to send Plug out to scout. [[File:Bayso-Snee-SargonaTeema.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Bayso and Snee sit in the wrecked Breon HOY-39 on Yavin 4. They look concerned.|Snee feared that Plug had been taken hostage.]] When Plug failed to return quickly, the group began to worry, and Snee suggested Bardi's faction might be messing with them. She, Flek, and Snur then expressed fear that he was a hostage, but Gerdis was unconcerned and pointed out that they still had the only pilot. As Snee was shocked to learn that Snur had already eaten his entire meal bar, Plug rushed back into the Breon HOY-39 and warned the group that Bardi's faction was turning the TIE to aim its weapons at them. After making some calculations on how long it would take, they began firing in the TIE's direction to slow their opponents down. ===All hands on deck=== {{Quote|I keep thinking it's thunder.''"
"''It's not.|Snee and Nazy discuss the sounds of the approaching Yavinian doodar|audio=Snee-Nazy-Doodar-SagronaTeema.flac|}} After night fell, Gerdis issued a challenge to Bardi, and both groups emerged from their ships into the middle of the rendezvous point, with Flek remaining behind to guard Andor. On the count of three, Snee and the others all lowered their weapons, and Bardi and Gerdis agreed to play [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]] to determine what happened next. With Bayso and Rowd chosen as seconds, the game began, and Snee watched as they played several rounds with at least two ending in a tie. With the others distracted and thunder to cover the noise, Andor broke free inside the Breon HOY-39 and subdued Flek before beginning to sneak toward the TIE Avenger. Those playing Five Hands then paused when rumbling sounds emanated from the surrounding [[tree]]s, with Snee commenting that she thought it might be thunder, although Nazy dismissed the idea. [[File:SneeFiring-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|325px|alt=Lit by a glowlamp, Snee fires onehanded in the direction of the Yavinian doodar on Yavin 4.|Snee and her allies tried to shoot the Yavinian doodar after it grabbed their leaders, but were soon left stranded by Cassian Andor.]] A [[Yavinian doodar]] then rushed from the treeline and grabbed Bardi and Gerdis in its [[Mouth|jaws]] before departing. Snee grabbed her blaster from the ground and fired aimlessly in the direction that the creature had gone. Flek then warned the brigade that their prisoner was getting away, causing Snee and the others to turn their fire on the starfighter. However, their weapons had no effect on the vessel, and Andor—whose experience with the Maya Pei Brigade had shown him how far the rebellion was from acting as a unified team{{SWYouTube|5SdMzzmeNsY|Andor Season 2 Declassified: Time}}—used the chaos to depart Yavin 4 aboard the TIE Avenger, leaving Snee and the others stranded once more. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|E chu ta!|Snee yells at Nazy in Huttese|audio=Snee-EChuTa-SagronaTeema.flac|}} Snee did not know where the surviving Maya Pei Brigade members should travel if they escaped Yavin 4 and had concerns about the group splitting to take multiple trips. When the survivors split into two factions, she sided with Gerdis and was angered by Crab's death when she found his foot. Snee was worried about how little food the faction had and concerned at the idea of Plug being a hostage. She had dark skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Snee spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard]] and Huttese. ==Equipment== Snee wore a gray [[jacket]], brown [[Clothing|pants]], black boots, and a brown [[belt]]. She used a blaster in combat. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Rika-Musk-Snee-MichaelWilkinson-Instagram.png|thumb|right|300px|Rika, Musk, and Snee stand posed in their rugged rebel costumes.|Michael Wilkinson worked on Snee and the rest of the Maya Pei Brigade's costumes, with Jackie Moody's team making them appropriately grubby.]] Snee was portrayed by actress [[Gloria Obianyo]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], first appearing in "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," the first and second episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], both of which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The Yavin jungle clearing scenes involving the Maya Pei Brigade were shot at [[Wikipedia:Longcross Studios|Longcross Studios]].{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}} Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] and concept artist [[Glyn Dillon]] worked on the costumes for the Maya Pei Brigade, treating them as threadbare survivalists who needed to contrast from the luxury refinement of costumes on [[Chandrila]], the sophistication of costumes on [[Coruscant]], and the agricultural workwear of [[Mina-Rau]], all other settings on the show.{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DLVGZ5Ox7tE|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-25|quote=For the threadbare survivalists of the #MayaPei gang, the costumes we created needed to seem far from the luxury and refinement of #Chandrila, the urbane sophistication of #Coruscant, and the agricultural workwear of #MinaRau. Illustrations by @glyn_dillon #costumedesign #starwars #andor #andorofficial #fashion #cdg892 #fyc costumes|archiveurl=https://archive.is/IGILm|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image1-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image2-Instagram.png|archivefile3=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image3-Instagram.png|archivefile4=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image4-Instagram.png|archivefile5=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image5-Instagram.png|archivefile6=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image6-Instagram.png|archivefile7=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image7-Instagram.png}} Snee and the other brigade members were made to appear sweaty and grubby by{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=s/aGlnaGxpZ2h0OjE3OTgzODQzMjAyODMwNDky?story_media_id=3663534388310792388|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-26|quote=Maya Pei brigade Made sweaty and grubby by the mighty Jackie Moody and her amazing breakdown team|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-GrubbyMayaPeiBrigade-InstagramReel.png}} chief textile artist [[Jackie Moody]] and her breakdown team. Prior to the episodes' release, Snee was revealed in a trailer for the series released on [[April 14]], 2025.{{SWYouTube|6XL5uHQTKo4|Andor | Cassian Andor | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|6XL5uHQTKo4|Andor | Cassian Andor | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|WUpflQHbJhc|Andor Season 2 | We Ask the Questions | Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Snee|imagecat=Images of Snee}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Snee |ja=スニー |ka=სნი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Maya Pei Brigade]]
